newsitem.title: UK: Jack top British boy's name, Sophie ousts Jessica.
newsitem.headline: Jack top British boy's name, Sophie ousts Jessica.

text.p: Jack was the most popular name given to boys born in England and Wales during 1996 but Sophie replaced Jessica as the top girl's name, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
There was remarkable stability in the list of boys' names where the top seven were, in order, Jack, Daniel, Thomas, James, Joshua, Matthew and Ryan -- the same as in 1995.
There was more movement among the girls, where Chloe jumped six places to number three, behind Jessica.
The top seven girls' names were Sophie, Jessica, Chloe, Emily, Lauren, Rebecca and Charlotte.
